:::{#exm-exponential-function}
#### Approximating $\expf{1}$

For $x = 1$, the terms $\paren{1 + \frac{1}{n}}^n$ are:

| $n$ | $\paren{1 + \frac{1}{n}}^n$ |
|----:|:----------------------------|
| $1$ | $2$ |
| $10$ | $2.59374\ldots$ |
| $100$ | $2.70481\ldots$ |
| $1000$ | $2.71692\ldots$ |

They approach $\expf{1} = 2.71828\ldots$.
For $x = 0$, every term is $\paren{1 + 0}^n = 1$, so $\expf{0} = 1$.

:::
